name: School of Abjuration
summary: Wizards of protective magic who shield themselves with an arcane ward.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.short: Copy abjuration spells for half the time and gold.
features.summary: The gold and time you must spend to copy a abjuration spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.short: Casting abjuration spells builds a damage-absorbing ward.
features.summary: When you cast an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher, you create (once per long rest) a ward with hit points equal to twice your wizard level + INT. It absorbs damage you take, and casting more abjuration spells recharges it by twice the spell level.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.short: Reaction: your ward absorbs damage for an ally.
features.summary: When a creature within 30 ft. takes damage, you can use your reaction to have your Arcane Ward absorb that damage.

features.name: Improved Abjuration
features.short: Add PB to ability checks made by your abjuration spells.
features.summary: When you cast an abjuration spell that requires an ability check (like Counterspell or Dispel Magic), add your proficiency bonus to that check.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.short: Advantage on saves against spells; resist spell damage.
features.summary: You have advantage on saving throws against spells, and resistance against the damage of spells.
